name: OppNet Fellows Program
what_you_do: A six-year program that starts the summer after 10th grade. You get college guidance, career workshops, SAT/ACT prep and five summers of paid internships or enrichment programs.
grades: Current 10th graders in New York City
who_can_apply: Students in 10th grade at a New York City high school. You show strong effort in school. Most Fellows apply with a GPA of 87 or above. You come from an under-resourced community. Your household income (AGI) is under $125,000. You should not already have similar college and career help. You must commit to the whole program.
pay_detail: Fellows do paid summer internships or enrichment programs (five summers over the six years). The page does not state the pay.
duration: Six years. Starts with a two-week Summer Institute in July 2027, then weekly after-school workshops in 11th and 12th grade.
deadline_text: Applications are due Feb 7, 2027 at 11:59 PM. Interviews are in March 2027. Admission news comes in April 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. It takes 1 to 2 hours. It needs your transcript, family facts and two recommendation forms. One is from a teacher. One is from a school counselor. Info sessions are Nov 12, Dec 3 and Jan 14. Chosen applicants are invited to interviews in March 2027.
notes: Admitted Fellows must come to all days of the Summer Institute. A family member must come to an orientation. The application asks for household income. The program uses it to check the income limit. The pages do not say if a work permit is needed.
